label: Inspected both earlier dossiers and the exact #445 model
summary:
Inspected both earlier dossiers and the exact #445 model. Materialized SEP-ABSTRACT-OBJECTS-2020-CRITERIA, especially sections 3.1–3.2; source findings, rejected stronger attribution, and rival objection are in docs/necessary-concrete-causal-powers.md. Replaced the opaque concreteness input in one explicit test with activation-sensitive recipient responses, a dormant world, distinct existing endpoints, a contingent recipient and zero-response control. Necessary bearer plus this capacity criterion is satisfiable; no impossibility of competing causal ontologies, actual or metaphysical possibility, or root discharge follows. Intrinsic causal directedness, spatiotemporal and independence/actuality criteria, abstract-object distinctions and counterpart alternatives remain open #435 work.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). 8b4e2a02 omits the world-indexed bridge requiring every existing individual at each accessible world to satisfy the supplied concrete classification. The empty concrete extension preserves DeRe for existence and falsifies DeDicto for existence conjoined with concreteness. The omitted bridge is off the root path and distinct from the intervention-response capacity condition in 8a2f7305. 8a2f7305 checks a separate populated capacity interpretation, with the necessary bearer capable through the response at true and no exercise at false. The counterpart zero-response assignment keeps existence and removes all capacities. The selected intervention-response capacity condition lacks a root-path statement.

Curation pass 2, lane D batch 4 (#2103, 2026-11-27). 8a2f7305 tests 390ac3ab. At the selected world `false`, access to `true` witnesses `AccessibleSuccessor`. Both distinct bearers exist at `true`, where activating bearer `false` changes the response of recipient `true`. The manifestation uses that successor, while all activation outputs at the selected world are false.
